pages.title: Police custody under BNSS Section 187(2): SC ruling

facts.text: Case: State of Andhra Pradesh vs Suda Suresh Veera Venkata Naga Raju — custodial death probe in AP
facts.head: Case

facts.text: Ruling: police custody can be sought in parts during the initial 40 or 60 days; ⚠ total still capped at 15 days
facts.head: Case

facts.text: Magistrate cannot impose a blanket "no extension" condition; SC allowed 7 more days (within 15)
facts.head: Case

facts.text: Section 38 BNSS: accused may meet an advocate during interrogation, not throughout
facts.head: Case

facts.text: Provision: Sec 58 BNSS; Rule: No detention beyond 24 hours without magistrate
facts.head: Law

facts.text: Provision: Sec 187(2) BNSS; Rule: Police custody 15 days total, in parts, within first 40/60 days
facts.head: Law

facts.text: Provision: Sec 187(3) BNSS; Rule: Detention up to 90 days (death/life/10+ years) or 60 days (others); then default bail
facts.head: Law

facts.text: Provision: Sec 167 CrPC (old); Rule: 15 days police custody, generally in the first 15 days
facts.head: Law

pages.title: Vande Mataram gets protection: National Honour (Amendment) Act 2026

facts.text: Act: Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Act, 2026 — amends Section 3 of the 1971 Act
facts.head: The amendment

facts.text: Effect: National Song (Vande Mataram) gets same protection as National Anthem — punishes intentional prevention or disturbance of singing
facts.head: The amendment

facts.text: Punishment: up to 3 years, fine or both; Section 3A (added 2003) — repeat offence minimum 1 year
facts.head: The amendment

facts.text: ⚠ Does not make singing compulsory, prescribe stanzas or punish respectful silence
facts.head: The amendment

facts.text: Passage: introduced Rajya Sabha 24 July 2026; passed RS 29 July, LS 30 July
facts.head: The amendment

facts.text: Enacted: 23 December 1971; Section 2 — Flag and Constitution (burning, defacing etc.)
facts.head: 1971 Act

facts.text: Composer: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee; first published in Bangadarshan, 7 November 1875; in novel Anandamath (1882)
facts.head: Vande Mataram history

facts.text: Tagore sang it at 1896 INC session, Calcutta; slogan on 7 August 1905 (Swadeshi)
facts.head: Vande Mataram history

facts.text: October 1937: CWC — only first two stanzas at official gatherings
facts.head: Vande Mataram history

facts.text: 24 January 1950: Rajendra Prasad — equal honour with Jana Gana Mana; ⚠ Constitution does not mention a "National Song"
facts.head: Vande Mataram history

facts.text: Bijoe Emmanuel v. State of Kerala (1986): Jehovah's Witness students — silence protected under Art 19(1)(a) and Art 25
facts.head: Vande Mataram history
